name: Smooth Typing
description: Halves the worst frame drops while typing. Discord updates its saved draft on every keystroke, re-rendering everything that shows drafts; this batches those updates until you pause. What you type is never delayed or lost.

notes: A message you just sent no longer comes back into the text box: the draft that was that message is dropped when it's sent. Switching channels and slash commands keep the box up to date too.
Fixed a message you just sent sometimes coming back into the text box, when you sent it right after typing.
